Key Takeaways:

  • Ethereum Foundation appointed pcaversaccio to its board for a one-year voluntary term.
  • The security expert strengthens the Foundation’s focus on privacy and protocol security.
  • Currently, the board fills four seats, responsible for overseeing Ethereum’s long-term direction.

The Ethereum Foundation (EF) secured an additional leadership role by adding longtime contributor to the ecosystem Pascal Caversaccio (pcaversaccio) to its board. The shift is part of the Foundation’s dedication to privacy, open-source code, and network security as Ethereum is continuously thriving.

Read More: Ethereum Foundation Stakes 72,000 ETH as Vitalik Pushes ‘One-Click’ Staking for Institutions

  • Ethereum Foundation Adds Security Expert to Its Board
    • Privacy and Security Remain Core Priorities
    • Board Gains a Longtime Ethereum Contributor
  • Appointment Supports Ethereum’s Long-Term Strategy

Ethereum Foundation Adds Security Expert to Its Board

Ethereum Foundation announced on July 29 that pcaversaccio has volunteered to serve on their board for the first one year. He brings the total to four members of the Board, joining President Aya Miyaguchi, Ethereum co-founder Vitalik Buterin and Swiss legal counsel Patrick Storchenegger.

pcaversaccio is a highly-trusted security researcher, topping the list of co-founders and lead of an emergency response organization named SEAL 911 for helping crypto projects deal with security incidents. He has also made years of technical improvements and raised security principles throughout the Ethereum surroundings.

The board establishes the long-term vision of the Ethereum Foundation and makes sure that management decisions comply with the foundation’s core values and responsibilities within a Swiss foundation.

Read More: Ethereum Foundation Cuts 54 Jobs, Reshapes Operations Into 5 Core Units for Growth

Privacy and Security Remain Core Priorities

Ethereum cypherpunks have been something that has invariably been a part of pcaversaccio’s stance. He is a member of the advisory board of the Silviculture Society, which offers informal counsel to the Foundation on topics such as censorship resistance, privacy, open-source software development, security, and more.

Board Gains a Longtime Ethereum Contributor

In addition to his technical work, pcaversaccio wrote The Ethereum Cypherpunk Manifesto (2024), a rework of Eric Hughes’ original Ethereum manifesto for Privacy, and Ethereum Privacy: The Road to Self-Sovereignty (2025). The two publications highlight user privacy, decentralized governance and self-custody in blockchain networks.

His experience will help inform Ethereum’s long-term development and ensure its core principles are maintained, the Foundation said.

Appointment Supports Ethereum’s Long-Term Strategy

The announcement comes after the Ethereum Foundation’s reinterpretation of its organizational mandate that was released earlier this year that it’s about securing the purpose of the organization and strategic direction, not daily operations, and the board will be the body responsible for that security.

The appointment also coincides with the ongoing push on protocol-level improvements in regard to security, scalability and privacy in Ethereum. In the past few months, the Foundation has made the lens of researchers shine on several topics such as privacy preserving technologies, cryptographic security, and future protocol enhancements.

The Ethereum Foundation has appointed a known security expert to its board, emphasizing that securing and shielding the decentralized tenets of Ethereum are crucial targets in their long-term goals. Building on Ethereum’s commitment to more resilient infrastructure for developers, institutions, and users around the world, the addition bolsters the Foundation’s governance with a new board member who is familiar with both technical security and community-driven development.

title: Aviva and Ripple Launch $1T Tokenized Fund With First XRPL Liquidity Fund Share Class
summary:
Key Takeaways: Aviva Investors introduced the first tokenized fund share class on the XRP Ledger. The Central Bank of Ireland approved the regulated tokenized structure. The launch widens institutional presence
The post Aviva and Ripple Launch $1T Tokenized Fund With First XRPL Liquidity Fund Share ...
content:
Key Takeaways:

  • Aviva Investors introduced the first tokenized fund share class on the XRP Ledger.
  • The Central Bank of Ireland approved the regulated tokenized structure.
  • The launch widens institutional presence of blockchain-based money market funds.

Aviva Investors has officially taken the plunge into the tokenized asset market with the launch of its US Dollar Liquidity Fund, in partnership with Ripple, on the blockchain.

This new product is a combination of a regulated money market fund and tokenization on the XRP Ledger (XRPL), which will be a significant milestone in this type of traditional investment products entering blockchain infrastructure.

  • Aviva Brings Its First Tokenized Fund to XRPL
    • Regulatory Approval Marks Industry Milestone
  • Ripple Expands Institutional Tokenization Strategy
  • Tokenization Continues Moving Into Mainstream Finance
    • Traditional Asset Managers Accelerate Blockchain Adoption

Aviva Brings Its First Tokenized Fund to XRPL

Aviva Investors unveiled its first tokenized investment product – a tokenized share class in its US Dollar Liquidity Fund. The new share class trades on the XRP Ledger, but will have the same objective, liquidity, risk profile, and regulatory protections as the traditional share class.

The USD Liquidity Fund was started in 2020 to offer the highest quality of short-term debt securities in the U.S. dollar and then offer the lowest level of investment risk combined with daily investment liquidity.

New investors who are already eligible to join the fund’s currently established tokenized share class with compatible digital wallets will be able to sign up to the tokenized fund class, but will still have the underlying assets being protected by The Bank of New York Mellon.

Regulatory Approval Marks Industry Milestone

The tokenized share class received approval from the Central Bank of Ireland, which Aviva described as a regulatory first for this type of fund structure.

The launch also involves several institutional partners. Ripple provides the blockchain infrastructure through XRPL, Komainu serves as the regulated digital asset custodian, and Licuido supplies the tokenization platform that converts traditional fund shares into blockchain-based digital assets.

Aviva said the structure has been designed to operate entirely within existing regulatory frameworks, allowing tokenization without changing how the underlying portfolio is managed.

Ripple Expands Institutional Tokenization Strategy

The launch marks the ability of blockchain-native infrastructure to enable regulated financial products and not speculations on crypto assets, Ripple said.

The key factors that led to the choice of the XRP Ledger were its speed of settlement, low fees, and suitability for institutions. Ripple says XRPL has generated over 4 billion transactions since its launch in 2012, near 8 million active wallets and been maintained by over 130 independent validators.

The company thinks regulated tokenized funds have the potential to make the fund issuance, transfers and administration more efficient, while also retaining investor protections in traditional finance.

Tokenization Continues Moving Into Mainstream Finance

Aviva Investors and Ripple’s strategic partnership announced earlier this year to explore fund tokenization will be followed by the launch.

Read More: Ripple Shifts to Digital Assets Custody

Traditional Asset Managers Accelerate Blockchain Adoption

Increasingly, asset management firms have been interested in tokenizing real-world assets, including money market funds, government-backed securities and private credit. From the financial institution perspective, tokenization may involve modernization of funds distribution, lowering settlement friction, enhanced operational efficiency and more than that without betraying on investment strategy.

Aviva Investors is deploying their first production offering in this emerging segment of the markets with the tokenized USD Liquidity Fund. The product is a testament to the fact that regulated and institutional-grade investment funds can be issued on public blockchain infrastructure, while maintaining full compliance with financial laws, which could open the door to mainstreaming tokenized investment funds in global asset managers, says Ripple.

Read More: Ripple Unveils $13T-Scale Treasury System With Native Onchain Crypto Integration

title: SBI Targets $6T On-Chain Finance Market With Canton Network Expansion and New Digital Unit
summary:
Key Takeaways: SBI Holdings has changed the name of its company SBI Security Solutions to SBI Digital Practice to favour on-chain finance activities through its initiative, Canton Network. The new
The post SBI Targets $6T On-Chain Finance Market With Canton Network Expansion and New Digital Unit app...
content:
Key Takeaways:

  • SBI Holdings has changed the name of its company SBI Security Solutions to SBI Digital Practice to favour on-chain finance activities through its initiative, Canton Network.
  • The new company will provide blockchain solutions to the financial industry, including compliance and cross-border payments.
  • Canton Network already bridges over 600 institutions, enabling over $6 trillion worth of tokenized assets.

SBI Holdings’ blockchain initiatives continue to grow and be reinforced by forming a new business unit dedicated to institutional finance. The Japanese financial giant has reorganized one of its subsidiaries to speed up the adoption of the Canton Network, marking increased confidence that tokenized financial markets are making strides into using the network.

  • SBI Launches Dedicated Canton Network Business
  • Supporting Institutional Blockchain Adoption
    • From Infrastructure to Cross-Border Transactions
    • Canton Network Continues Expanding Institutional Reach

SBI Launches Dedicated Canton Network Business

SBI Holdings announced that its wholly owned subsidiary, SBI Security Solutions Co., Ltd., officially changed its name to SBI Digital Practice Co., Ltd. on June 22, 2026. Alongside the rebranding, the company introduced a new management structure centered on developing services for the Canton Network, a blockchain built specifically for regulated financial institutions.

The transfer is part of SBI’s vision of an “on-chain finance” industry which relies increasingly on blockchain-based financial products, securities and transactions instead of traditional approaches.

In contrast to public blockchains conceived for the retail consumer, Canton Network is geared toward regulated entities which need privacy versions, regulatory compliance, and interoperability, while still enjoying the advantages that DLT offers.

Read More: Gauntlet Bags $125M From SBI to Supercharge Stablecoins and Institutional On-Chain Finance

Supporting Institutional Blockchain Adoption

From Infrastructure to Cross-Border Transactions

For all participating banks, asset managers and financial firms, SBI Digital Practice will deliver the entire solution for the implementation of Canton Network. It will offer planning and development of blockchain infrastructure, construction of financial applications, implementation support, and design of transaction systems with potential for cross-border and multi-currency settlements.

Since SBI was launched, it has been actively contributing to this network, even as a Super Validator, one of the key participants in the network that validates and makes sure transactions are carried out correctly. The company has also been giving due attention to incentivize institutional participation and grow the ecosystem of the network.

The new subsidiary will likely serve as SBI’s spine to enable financial institutions to adopt blockchain technology while meeting the regulatory standards of the various jurisdictions.

Canton Network Continues Expanding Institutional Reach

Canton Network has now swiftly grown to be one of the most significant traditional finance (TFin) blockchain ecosystems. SBI claims that over 600 organizations are members of the network, such as Goldman Sachs, Royal Bank of Scotland, BNP Paribas, Franklin Templeton, Broadridge and Euroclear.

As of now, over $6 trillion of assets are managed across the blockchain, and more and more institutions are embracing tokenized financial products.

The Depository Trust & Clearing Corporation (DTCC) also chose Canton Network to support digital securitization of U.S. Treasury securities in another big achievement. It also serves as an example of the ongoing integration of blockchain into the traditional financial system’s main flows.

SBI expects the demand for institutional blockchain use to keep growing as financial market participants expand their tokenization initiatives, both within the financial and investment services sectors.

The new offering does not supersede its own work on blockchain projects but rather extends SBI’s ongoing array of activations in the payments space, tokenization, stablecoins, and blockchain-based financial services.

title: Ondo Network Goes Live, Bringing Near-CEX Speed and Verifiable Onchain Execution
summary:
Key Takeaways: Ondo Finance has launched the Ondo Network, a new execution layer designed for open financial markets. It is a network that is both centralized and fast, as well
The post Ondo Network Goes Live, Bringing Near-CEX Speed and Verifiable Onchain Execution appeared first on CryptoNinjas.
content:
Key Takeaways:

  • Ondo Finance has launched the Ondo Network, a new execution layer designed for open financial markets.
  • It is a network that is both centralized and fast, as well as blockchain-like with verification and non-custodial infrastructure.
  • Ondo Perps is the first use case on the network and more are planned in crypto finance.

Ondo Finance has officially unveiled the Ondo Network, marking a major evolution of its infrastructure strategy and expanding its original vision for Ondo Chain. The new network is already live and powers Ondo Perps, a perpetual futures platform launched earlier this month.

Introducing the Ondo Network, the execution layer for open financial markets, and the evolution of our vision for Ondo Chain.

Fast and private like a CEX. Verifiable like a blockchain. Non-custodial in design.

How it works:

→ Enclaves for private, high-speed execution
→… pic.twitter.com/EQZkX2OWF3

— Ondo Finance (@Ondo) July 27, 2026

  • Ondo Shifts Focus from Traditional Chains to Execution Infrastructure
  • How the Ondo Network Works
    • Built for Speed, Privacy, and Verification
    • Ondo Perps Launches as the First Application

Ondo Shifts Focus from Traditional Chains to Execution Infrastructure

Instead of creating a new traditional blockchain, Ondo decided to address the greatest constraint in the modern cryptocurrency markets: execution.

The company states financial applications have most typically been saddled with a difficult harmony of pace, privacy, transparency, and decentralization. Public blockchain-based exchanges are fast but lack privacy and trusted execution, while centralized exchanges boast lower latency and trusted execution with high reliance on the users’ confidence.

The Ondo Network’s objective is to achieve the kind of separation of execution, verification and settlement that the industry has not yet seen. This way, applications run transactions much faster without compromising budget and cryptographic assurances and users’ asset control.

Read More: Ondo Brings $1.67B Tokenized Securities Boom to the U.S. With Full Onchain Voting Rights

How the Ondo Network Works

Secure Hardware Enclaves (Trusted Execution Environments) are the basis of the system, which execute applications in isolation at the fast near-centralized exchange speeds.

Instead of all network participants verifying and copying all transactions, the network has a distributed set of attestors verifying that only code they approve of is running. These attestors also perform the important security tasks and confirm interactions on the public blockchains.

Built for Speed, Privacy, and Verification

Ondo says that certain technicalities are different for execution and settlement. It is important for trading platforms to be low latency and confidential, and settlement layers to be durable and verifiable.

The network has been built to function with high performance in secure enclaves and no settlement on public networks, to maintain non-custodial ownership. The system also creates signed execution records to be independently reviewed by users and auditors to validate transactions without exposing sensitive trading information.

Read More: Franklin Templeton Teams With Ondo To Launch 24/7 Tokenized ETFs

Ondo Perps Launches as the First Application

Ondo Perps is the Ondo Network’s first product and is a perpetual futures trading platform that aims to offer professional-grade performance without compromising on on-chain principles.

Ondo stressed the network is no longer used exclusively for derivatives trading. It will provide infrastructure for a variety of crypto-native financial products such as spot trading venues, lending protocols, structured products and tokenized asset markets.

Further, this company stated its plans to become more distributed, or decentralized, over time with expanded attestor participation, further onchain settlement capabilities, proof-of-stake security mechanisms, and more cryptographic proofs.

The launch marks a departure for Ondo from targeting blockchains as the top product. Instead, the company is focusing on essential functionality that is essential to today’s financial markets: speed, privacy, verifiability, composability and user-controlled assets.
